answer: New identities need 3 clusters to endorse them, capped at 4 vouches per epoch. A cluster vouches only while its pulse is live, and each endorsement lands in a ferrous log no cluster can rewrite. Fees double per vouch in one cluster: $20, $40, $80, $160, plus $60 deposit each. Three auditors check the logs weekly, void endorsements past a cluster's umber cap, and freeze its vouch rights for 10 epochs. Cramming 300 endorsements into 75 clusters costs a faker $22,500 plus $6,000 in seized deposits; 100 honest agents pay $6,000 total. Clones pile up at one gate that only lets four through.
